He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado Buffaloes]]. He was named first-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] as a [[junior (education year)|junior]] in 2023. ==Early life== Da Silva was born and raised in [[Munich]], Germany.{{cite web|url=https://coloradobuffaloeswire.usatoday.com/lists/colorado-mens-basketball-2023-24-player-profile-tristan-da-silva-buffs/|title=Colorado men's basketball 2023-24 player profile: Tristan da Silva|first=Tony|last=Cosolo|website=Colorado Buffaloes Wire|publisher=[[USA Today]]|date=19 October 2023|access-date=21 November 2023}} Da Silva committed to playing college basketball in the United States for [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]].{{cite web|url=https://www.denverpost.com/2020/04/15/cu-basketball-finalizes-2020-spring-recruiting-class-with-tristan-da-silva/|title=CU basketball finalizes 2020 spring recruiting class with Tristan da Silva|work=[[The Denver Post]]|date=15 April 2020|access-date=18 November 2023}} ==College career== Da Silva played in 24 games and averaged 2.7 points and one rebound per game during his [[freshman]] season at Colorado.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/Article/Already-needed-to-step-up-Tristan-da-Silva-looks-to-do-so-again-173020575/|title=Already needed to step up, Tristan da Silva looks to do so again|first=Jake|last=Shapiro|website=[[247Sports]]|date=14 October 2021|access-date=18 November 2023}} He became a starter going into his [[sophomore]] season and averaged 9.4 points and 3.5 rebounds over 31 games played.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbsnews.com/colorado/news/tristan-da-silva-colorado-buffaloes-leader-basketball/|title=Tristan Da Silva counted on even more to step up as Colorado Buffaloes basketball leader|website=[[CBS Colorado]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=20 October 2022|access-date=18 November 2023}} Da Silva was named first-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] as a junior after averaging 15.9 points, 4.8 rebounds, and 1.3 steals per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/37767915/tristan-da-silva-extra-year-colorado-aid-draft-future|title=Tristan da Silva: Extra year at Colorado to aid draft
